news.title: Jeffries responds to Kushner meeting backlash: ‘No one from the Trump Cartel is getting a pass’
news.summary: House Minority Leader Hakeem Jeffries (D-N.Y.) on Monday said that “no one from the Trump Cartel is getting a pass,” in a post on the social media platform X.
